source: Own measurement, 2026-11-05: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, which installs solution/privileged/oracle.py at sha256 84a75a0b17ff80d5 with the reference token) through this build's verify on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json, sha256 68eba794bb1bc5bf), in two fresh CPU containers of the task image (sha256:936a11f61045, CPython 3.12.14, 2 CPUs, no network) run the way the separate verifier runs it (tests/review/regrade.sh; runs t2pr10-anchor1 and t2pr10-anchor2): 48 of 48 docked, episode qualities 0.9776-0.9876, mean_docking_quality 0.9835537203921798 in both, every metric of the two verdicts identical; the value is the lowest of the two. The selection runs of the same 48 seeds (the same controller as a fresh program per episode) gave the same 48 qualities to the last bit: on the fixed set the reference is deterministic. ale validate's oracle pass is still to be recorded.
reference_commit: ab24b6f (the privileged reference 84a75a0b since 08ccda6; the fixed set since ab24b6f)
note: Measured, not drawn: every submission meets the same 48 episodes, and the reference repeats its score to the last bit. full_at 0.98 absorbs exactly one lost dock, the margin for a last-bit libm difference on another host flipping one episode: losing the best episode, even as a collision, leaves reward 0.9991, which rounds to 1.00; two lost docks give 0.978. A submission earns reward 1.0 from mean_docking_quality 0.96388. The non-privileged reference (solution/reference/, the task author's identifying controller) scores 0.53997 on the set in a fresh container (26 of 48 docked, the lock 794 of 1064 probes), ratio 0.549, reward 0.56. Before (2026-10-21): value 0.4580 with full_at 0.75, the author's controller on fresh draws, so that 16 docks of 48 earned full reward.
